description.value:
Your techniques burn at the full furnace of your cosmo, not half.

Your Techniques' rank is equal to half your level rounded up, plus 1, to a maximum of rank 10. Your Techniques heighten one step ahead of the standard focus-rank schedule — an 11th-level Saint casts at rank 7 rather than rank 6. This applies to every Technique you know, including Cloth Abilities and boon-granted Techniques.

Balance note: this is deliberately a capstone-tier feat. Against the rank spine it advances every damage Technique by one heightening step, roughly +15% Technique output. It sits at 10th level alongside comparable martial power feats and should be watched in play.
